answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 10040 Country: India Title: asslamualykum i want to ask question how to cut pubic hairs what r condition till wherte it can be shaved?also should we cut hairs through anal passage? Question: asslamualykum i want to ask question how to cut pubic hairs what r condition till wherte it can be shaved?also should we cut hairs through anal passage? Answer ID: 10040 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 212/171=H/1429) The pubic hair can be removed with blade, razor or hair-remover creams. A man should remove the hair on and around penis and testicles, the hair on thigh which may get smeared with impurity and the hair around anus. The detail is mentioned in Fatwa Shami etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
